name: pixel-fill-button
title: Pixel Fill Button
description: An outlined mono button split by a dashed rule. Hover and teal pixels bloom out from the exact point the cursor came in, each flashing lime before it settles, so a lime edge rides the wave; leave and they drain out through the point you left by. The label rolls up and the arrow slides through as it fills.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/pixel-fill-button
GSAP plugins (CustomEase) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
